messages.content: Decide only whether this one authoritative source unit crosses an internal LARGE H3 chapter phase boundary. Return JSON only.

SOURCE UNIT:
The technician diagnoses the fault, replaces the sensor, and confirms the repair.

A chapter is a LARGE H3 refresh unit.
Choose SPLIT only in either case:
1. this unit contains an explicit substantial time jump/scene break between two narrative phases; or
2. this unit explicitly describes a long/repeated main process (for example majority, most, repeatedly, throughout, or equivalent duration/repetition wording) followed by its explicit terminal resolution. A one-time finite action chain is NOT this case.
Otherwise choose KEEP_TOGETHER. Ordinary movement, danger changes, tool/weapon changes, terminal resolution plus immediate closure, and continuous work stay together.
Choose one: SPLIT or KEEP_TOGETHER.
Return JSON with keys decision and reason.

message.content: {"decision":"KEEP_TOGETHER","reason":"The unit contains a single, concise series of actions (diagnose, replace, confirm) with no explicit time jumps, scene breaks, or repeated processes that would warrant splitting across chapter phases."}
